speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; have these symptoms started suddenly or developed gradually over a few days?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. The sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, and fatigue at 30 weeks gestation is concerning; did you experience a stiff neck, photophobia, or a rash as well? Also, have you noticed any change in the frequency of your urination or any vaginal bleeding?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming your symptoms. The history of eating ice cream three days prior to the sudden onset of fever, headache, and anorexia is highly suggestive of Listeria infection. Did you experience any diarrhea, muscle aches, or back pain as well? I will also need to check your vital signs; can you confirm your current blood pressure and heart rate?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. The patient is currently pregnant, at her 30th week of gestation. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. No recent travels or contact with sick individuals. No known allergies.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listerial Meningitis (or severe listeriosis).
I am prepared to confirm the diagnosis with a Lumbar Puncture and Serum Listeria antigen test.
